text:
packet-05 - first reader response (unverified image reading)

Exposure statement: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or reading of this record. The only external labels I saw are the modern pencil shelf-labels written on the fragments themselves in the photographs ("Stams, STA, Frg. 109_Nr" etc.).

== LAYOUT SURVEY (written from overview image-001.jpg) ==
Face 1 (image-001, overview): twelve separate small paper strips/fragments laid out in a 4 x 3 grid on black cloth, with colour checker at lower left and cm scale at right. Each strip is roughly 10-11 cm wide x 6-7 cm high, ragged at the lower edge, with the same pattern of worm/insect holes (they were evidently stacked or cut from one block). Each carries a modern pencil label "Stams, STA, Frg. 109_Nr" with N = 1..12 and side r:
  row 1: 9r (left), 8r (middle), 1r (right)
  row 2: 10r, 7r, 2r
  row 3: 11r, 6r, 3r
  row 4: 12r, 5r, 4r
Script: German cursive (Kurrent) in brown ink, vernacular German prose, written in long lines that run off the strip edges (strips are cut out of larger sheets, so each line is truncated left and/or right). Some strips show large flourished calligraphic capitals/strokes (8r, 7r, 2r, 12r) and what look like Latin-script headings in a different, more upright hand: on 2r "replicat vnnd ..."? at top right, "Contra" at lower right; on 8r a large flourished capital. On 10r and 3r a phrase is underlined in red crayon with a red marginal note (number-like) at right: 10r "...hundert ... dreissig" ; 3r "funffzehenhundert" - these look like year dates underlined later in red. Tentative interpretation: fragments of a legal/administrative document (pleadings: "replicat", "Contra", "Commissarij"?) cut up for binder's waste. Not a manuscript book; no columns, no ruling visible.
Tiles image-002..010 are the native-resolution 3 x 3 tiling of this face (rows top->bottom, columns left->right), overlapping.
Other faces (overviews image-011, -021, -031, -038) not yet viewed at time of writing this survey.

== TRANSCRIPTION ==

--- image-002.jpg (face 1, tile row1 col1: strip 9r full; top of strip 10r below) ---
Strip 9r (lines cut at left edge; text continues past right? no - right side of strip blank after ca. 2/3 width, lines end inside the strip):
002 l1: ...ber an [?]khend(t)? zuuorlassen? fur
002 l2: ...n Augenschein? einzunemen, vnnd
002 l3: ...gst? in schein? zulassen,
   (blank zone ca. 2 lines' height, with pencil label "Stams, STA, Frg. 109_9r")
002 l4: ...erwundern sich das [?]eclarte? nach
002 l5: ...lich? wider formb Rechten, ab
002 l6: [only ascenders visible, cut by lower edge]
Strip 10r (top part):
002 l7: ...[?]jacob? [illegible] dem Comissar(ij)?
002 l8: ...chen? erteillen, | Das? mit   (large looped flourish before "Das")
002 l9: ...el Beraun[?] dem Closter Zur?
002 l10: ...zehenhundert Ainundreissig?  (this phrase underlined in red crayon on the overview; red marginal figure at right reads "(6)35"? or "1535"? - modern red note)
Note: hand is a fluent Kurrent chancery hand; long s, loops on d/h; "vnnd" with double n.

--- image-003.jpg (face 1, tile row1 col2: strip 8r; top of strip 7r) ---
Strip 8r (text only in right half; left half blank; lines cut at right edge):
003 l1: ...in Clager bleiben?
003 l2: ...vnnd haben zu kain?
   (large looped calligraphic capital flourish occupying middle)
003 l3: Bej Ort[...]   (flourished capital B; possibly a new section opening "Bej ...")
003 l4: Hieruber? durch das [...]   (initial H with huge flourish)
003 l5: [tops of letters only, cut by lower edge]
Strip 7r (top; text in right half):
003 l6: Auf solches begeren [...]   (flourished initial A)
003 l7: vnnd die [?]aspzung? a[...]
003 l8: tunder? verschaffen, [...]
003 l9: solches Schrifftlich? an[...]

--- image-004.jpg (face 1, tile row1 col3: strip 1r; top of strip 2r) ---
Strip 1r (left edge torn; lines run in from left; right half blank):
004 l1: [...]mi[...]  (faint, abraded top line; only minims)
004 l2: ...ebanb? Eur? [?]est(er)r(eich)? herrn,   (superscript mark over the "e/o" of 3rd word)
004 l3: ...| vnnd Euch herrn [?]neb[?]ob:
004 l4: ...stellen? gericht, sambt deinst?:
004 l5: ...ndlicher? handlichen? haben?,
004 l6: Commissarien,
004 l7: Commissiongericht?,   (cut by lower edge; reading "[C]ommission gericht" uncertain)
Note: the colon-like ":" after "ob" and "deinst" appears to be a punctuation/abbrev. mark.
Strip 2r (top):
004 l8: [large flourish] replica[t]? vnnd di[...]   (heading-like, in a more upright, larger hand with ink of different tone; "replica" fairly clear; a stroke crosses "ca")
004 l9: [large flourished capital] N. ?Imnalheim? der? [...]  (faint; uncertain)

--- image-005.jpg (face 1, tile row2 col1: strip 10r lower part; strip 11r) ---
Strip 10r (overlaps 002 l8-l10; repeated lines not counted again):
005 l1 (= 002 l9): ...el Beran[?]? dem Closter zur? [/]
005 l2 (= 002 l10): ...[z]ehenhundert Ainundreissig   (underlined in red crayon; red marginal "(15)35"? - the red figure looks like "1535" with first digits partly in a circle; modern)
   (blank ca. 2 lines; pencil label "Stams, STA, Frg. 109_10r")
005 l3: ...[?]higer? dann vmb erstreckhung
005 l4: [tops only, cut by lower edge]
Strip 11r (text in right half, cut at right edge):
005 l5: geren? bezaichter? sche[...]
005 l6: Thaler furgeben, | da[...]
005 l7: man oberkhait?, so[...]
005 l8: wellen aber hierinn? [...]
005 l9: vnnd mit der Zeram[...]?   (word after "der" uncertain)
005 l10: ...nnder? [?]urcht?, zu[...]

--- image-006.jpg (face 1, tile row2 col2: strip 7r lower; strip 6r) ---
Strip 7r (overlap with 003 l7-l9). Revision on seeing this tile: the word I gave as "[?]aspzung?" at 003 l7 is the same word form as on 6r below, which reads best as "Tagsatzung" (T + a + g-loop + s + a + tz + ung), so:
006 l1 (= 003 l7): vnnd die Tagsatzung? a[...]
006 l2 (= 003 l8): tunder? verschaffen, | [?]n[...]
006 l3 (= 003 l9): solches Schrifftlich an[...]
   (blank ca. 3 lines; pencil label "Stams, STA, Frg. 109_7r")
006 l4: [huge flourished capital O/D] Oder Closter? auch Ern[...]?   (or "Oder kloster ..."; uncertain)
006 l5: [tops only, cut by torn lower edge]
Strip 6r (text in right half, cut at right edge):
006 l6: schaffe bringen? sol? [...]   (uncertain; ink partly flaked)
006 l7: beilagen, Hierin? rechtl[...]
006 l8: das auf derselben wo[...]
006 l9: Zwainzigisten Augu[sti]?   (underlined in red crayon - looks like a date: "twentieth ... August")
006 l10: Augenschein, vnnd am[...]
006 l11: Rechtliche Tagsatzung a[...]
006 l12: [cut by lower edge]

--- image-007.jpg (face 1, tile row2 col3: strip 2r lower; strip 3r) ---
Strip 2r (overlap with 004 l9). Revised reading of 004 l9 on this clearer view:
007 l1 (= 004 l9): [flourished capital] N. Anwalthaber der   (Kurrent, not the upright hand; "N." = placeholder name?)
007 l2: vier[?]el?,   (short line, possibly "vierzehen"? uncertain)
007 l3: Contra   (larger, upright Latin letters with flourished C; heading-like, at right)
007 l4: [lower edge: loop of another flourish only]
Strip 3r (text from left torn edge across most of strip; cut at left):
007 l5: ...es?, | Als? dar[umb]? an disem rechts[...]   (strike or flourish through "dar..." - possibly a deletion: a horizontal line runs through the 2nd-3rd words)
007 l6: ...zettel? Recht gehabt, oder vermuest?
007 l7: ...ehe? Zwaisp? so lannge Zeit,
007 l8: ...[?] Funffzehenhundert vnnd?   (underlined red; red modern marginal note "1580?")
007 l9: ...[?]rester? Jar, in welliche[m] dise[...]   ("dise" + cut)
007 l10: ...fallen sey, mit Stillschweigen,
007 l11: ...[?] herumb? recht [...]  (cut by lower edge)

--- image-008.jpg (face 1, tile row3 col1: strip 11r lower; strip 12r) ---
Strip 11r (overlap with 005 l8-l10):
